thread: tara.docs: hey team — i'm tossing the changelog draft for the recent deploy into this thread. high level + known issues included, but i want a quick pass for accuracy before we publish. PR: #3427 simon.eng: taking a look now. can we add a short SDK snippet for the new streaming hooks? folks keep asking for a minimal node/python example. :eyes: alex.md: saw one broken anchor on the migration guide -> the anchor for the embedding section (`#embedding-api`) 404s when viewed from the changelog. appears to be a header rename in the migration doc. ben.qa: link-checker shows 2 failures: the embedding anchor and the dedicated->private migration note that points to the old appendix. i can paste the failing lines if helpful. :bug: link-checker-bot: 1769996605: link-checker found 2 broken links in sources/docs/content/migration/dedicated-to-private.md: line 78 (../apis/embeddings#embedding-api), line 201 (../appendix/old-routing). tara.docs: thanks — ben, paste the failing lines. alex, can you update the anchor or add a redirect? prefer redirect so older changelog permalinks still work. ben.qa: failing lines: `See Embeddings at ../apis/embeddings#embedding-api` and `See routing appendix ../appendix/old-routing` alex.md: i can add a small anchor fallback and push a tiny doc update. will add an HTML anchor like "" above the new header so the changelog link keeps working. pushing in a sec. simon.eng: for the SDK snippet — propose two 1-liners: node streaming and python with `async for token in stream`. short, copy-pastable. example: ```js const resp = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rdi-8k', input: 'Hello' }); for await (const chunk of resp) console.log(chunk.text); ``` simon.eng: and python: ```py async for token in client.responses.stream(model='rdi-8k', input='Hello'): print(token.text, end='') ``` tara.docs: perfect. keep them minimal. i'll add a tiny note about latency variation for streaming on smaller quantized models. also need a short "known issue" blurb about temporary higher tail-latency on rdi-8k after the kernel swap — ops already rolled a mitigation. ben.qa: can we be explicit about which customers are impacted? ops said <1% on hosted, higher on dedicated low-burst configs. also mention the workaround: pin to rdi-legacy-8k or enable fallback routing. tara.docs: ok: "Known issue: increased tail latency on rdi-8k after kernel upgrade. Impact: <1% hosted requests; dedicated low-burst pools more affected. Workaround: pin to `rdi-legacy-8k` or enable fallback routing in Console." good? alex.md: pushed anchor fallback and small link fix. PR: #3429. also added a short redirect note in the migration doc's frontmatter so the old appendix path resolves. simon.eng: added SDK snippets as gists and put inline blocks in the draft. PR: #3430 (docs). left a TODO to mention token-charge behavior for streamed responses. ben.qa: re-run link-checker after merges pls. i have a quick smoke script that checks rendered site links. link-checker-bot: 1769996702: PR #3429 merged. 1769996720: PR #3430 merged. tara.docs: awesome. ben, can you run smoke? i'll hold the publish until we have a clean run and a final editorial pass (one-liner feature highlights + updated changelog date). target publish window EOD today. :memo: ben.qa: running now. will report back in ~2m. ben.qa: smoke results: all links pass, except one trailing double-slash on an external partner link. filing tiny follow-up PR to strip it. tara.docs: thanks — i think we're green. final ask: @simon.eng can you add a half-sentence about the model catalog change (we renamed `rdi-legacy` -> `rdi-compat`) so customers don't get confused when they search in Console? simon.eng: done. added phrase: "Note: `rdi-legacy` was renamed to `rdi-compat` — aliases remain for 30 days." PR updated. tara.docs: perfect. publishing now. i'll ping #general once live with the short blurb and link. :tada: simon.eng: nice. thanks everyone! alex.md: thanks!
